4.2 BSW Scheduling
[RS_BSWMD_00053] Cyclic time based scheduling of BSW Main Functions ⌈
Description:
The BSWMD template SHALL provide means to describe the cyclic time based
scheduling requirements of BSW Main Functions.
Rationale:
The RTE Generator creates the scheduling for the whole ECU. Many BSW
Modules rely on the cyclic time based call of their main functions in order to
fulfill their functionality. The RTE Generator shall be able to implement the
cyclic time based call based on the stated requirements.
Dependencies:
–
Use Case:
Call of the function "Com_MainFunctionTx()" from the generated RTE to
achieve periodic sending of IPdus.
Supporting
Material:
–

[RS_BSWMD_00054] Mode Switches for BSW modules shall be supported ⌈
Description:
The BSWMD template SHALL provide means to describe Mode Switches for
BSW modules and the requirements on the scheduling.
Rationale:
Conditional scheduling of BSW Main Functions dependent on different
operating modes of the ECU.
BSW Main Functions are
scheduled dependent on modes
activated by entering or exiting a mode
activated at particular mode transitions

Use Case:

Different communication modes (Mode provided by the ComM)
